modules.module_title: Select the site for coconut cultivation

pcs.pc_description: select a site with conducive agro-climatic conditions for the cultivation of coconut, ensuring it has accessibility to the relevant markets
ensure the site does not have shallow and clay soil with underlying hard rocks, and free from water stagnation
ensure the availability of required inputs at the site such as quality water, electricity, seeds, fertilisers, pesticides, insecticides, etc.
co-ordinate with an approved laboratory for soil-testing to ensure nematodes are not present in the soil
select the appropriate variety of coconut to be cultivated according to the soil at the site and expected yield
estimate the requirement of various resources such as labour, seed nuts, fertilisers, pesticides, etc.
select an approved vendor based on the quality and price of the planting material, ensuring the seed nuts have a high survival rate
purchase the necessary resources in the required quantity and store them as per their storage requirements, ensuring hygiene along with the recommended temperature and humidity
prepare the nursery bed in the recommended dimensions
arrange to protect the nursery bed from direct sunlight with the help of artificial shading
treat the planting material with the appropriate pesticide, insecticide or fungicide, using them in the dose recommended by the government’s agriculture department or relevant agricultural university
sow seeds in the seedbed at the recommended depth and spacing
carry out nutrition, disease and pest management of seedlings and maintain them in the nursery for the recommended period, ensuring hygienic conditions
check the seedlings to determine their maturity for being harvested
harvest the seedlings using the appropriate tools and implements, and store them under the recommended temperature and humidity
discard the diseased and damaged seedlings in an environment-friendly manner

modules.module_title: Prepare the field for transplanting seedlings

pcs.pc_description: remove all roots, debris and waste materials from the field
check the moisture level in the soil to ensure it is appropriate for tilling
till the field to the required depth using the relevant farm machineries
apply mulch in the field to prevent the growth of weeds
create drains in the field for effective drainage of water
prepare pits of the recommended depth and width for transplanting seedlings and ensure their healthy growth
select the appropriate time for transplanting coconut seedlings according to the agro-climatic zone at the site
fill the pits with the mixture of topsoil and compost up to the recommended level
transplant the seedlings in the pits and apply soil cover on the roots
carry out gene stacking as per the requirement
apply fertilisers to the soil and water the seedlings with the recommended quantity
check the soil’s pH level using a pH meter and adjust it by applying lime or gypsum in the recommended quantity
coordinate with an authorised lab to check the soil’s macro and micronutrient levels
apply the lab-recommended organic or inorganic fertilisers to the soil in the recommended quantity and as per the prescribed schedule
adopt the recommended cultural practices to enhance the level of soil nutrients
carry out intercropping with the recommended crops for the best utilisation of soil nutrients
apply the recommended weedicides/ herbicides as per instructions from the government’s agriculture department or the relevant agricultural university
carry out manual or mechanical weeding according to the size of coconut farm and extent of weed infestation
follow the recommended weeding schedule for effective control of weeds and rogue infected plants

modules.module_title: Perform integrated pest and disease management

pcs.pc_description: monitor the crop regularly to identify the signs of physiological disorders along with pest and disease infestation such as rhinoceros beetle, black-headed caterpillar, red palm weevil, termites, bud rot, leaf rot, stem bleeding, etc.
determine the stage of pest and disease infestation along with the mode of transmission
follow the recommended practices to control pests such as adopting the natural enemies of coconut crop pests
apply the recommended pesticides/insecticides as per the prescription to remove and control pests and disease
maintain the record of pesticides and insecticides used in the field
follow the recommended irrigation method and schedule appropriate for the coconut crop
adopt the relevant precision farming methods for the best utilisation of irrigation water
apply mulch, coconut husk or coir pith to the soil to conserve soil moisture and prevent irrigation water from evaporating
optimise the usage of water and other resources in various tasks and processes
plug water leakages to prevent its wastage
segregate waste into appropriate categories
recycle the recyclable waste appropriately and dispose non-recyclable waste in an environment-friendly manner

pcs.pc_description: dry copra following appropriate drying methods, such as sun drying, smoke drying, kiln drying and indirect hot air drying
check the moisture levels in the dry copra to ensure it has the optimum moisture content for further processing
remove the nut from the hard shell and pare off the thin brown rind, following the recommended practices to prevent contamination by flecks of brown
wash the pared nuts free of milk and skin residues
shred the nuts using the shredding machine to obtain the milled product of the required degree of fineness
carry out steam or hot water treatment of the ground meat to destroy salmonella and lipases and reduce bacteria count to the recommended levels
dry the pasteurized meat on a wire mesh belt using hot air to reduce the moisture content to the recommended levels
carry out sieving to obtain different grades of the desiccated coconut, such as extra fine, macaroon (fine), medium and coarse
separate coconut meat from the coconut shell to obtain copra, following the recommended practices
carry out sun drying and smoke drying of copra for the recommended duration
chop the copra into small pieces of recommended size and heat them at the recommended temperature for an appropriate duration
squeeze coconut oil out from the cooked copra using the expeller and filter it using the filter press
crack the coconut shells and separate the coconut meat
chop the fresh coconut meat and slice it into thin flakes of the desired size
cook the thin flakes of coconut meat in a cooker, heating them at the recommended temperature for an appropriate duration
extract coconut oil from the heat-treated cooked coconut meat using the oil expeller
use air tight containers for packing the extracted oil and store it in a dark, cool and dry storage area
extract Tender Coconut Water (TCW) following the recommended practices ensuring hygiene
pack the TCW in pouches and aluminium cans using the appropriate technology to retain its flavour for the appropriate period before consumption

modules.module_title: Carry out the processing of tender coconut

pcs.pc_description: prepare a solution of citric acid and potassium metabisulphite using them in the recommended quantity
carry out the processing of tender coconut in citric acid and potassium metabisulphite solution for the recommended duration to facilitate their storage for appropriate duration and transportation
store the processed tender coconuts at the recommended temperature
select coconuts of appropriate maturity suitable for making snow ball tender nut
create a groove on the shell of the coconut using an appropriate tool before scooping out the globular tender
extract round soft kernel/snow ball tender nut from the coconut shell using the appropriate tool, ensuring to maintain the kernel and water intact in it
pack the snow ball tender nut in the appropriate LDPE film packaging and store it at the recommended temperature

modules.module_title: Prepare fruit juice blended tender coconut water

pcs.pc_description: select appropriate fruits, such as pomegranate, blue grapes, pineapple, mango and lemon juice, to be used for preparing fruit juice blended tender coconut water beverage
prepare fruit juice blended tender coconut water beverage using the selected fruits, following the recommended practices
ensure the prepared fruit juice blended tender coconut water is stored at an appropriate temperature
collect coconut water of mature nuts and carry out filtration
follow the recommended practices to adjust pH, taste, total soluble sugar and shelf life of coconut water
carry out pasteurisation and filtration activities
carry out bottling of coconut water to be used as a carbonated/ non-carbonated beverage
prepare the culture solution by mixing coconut water with sugar and acetic acid at a stipulated proportion
inoculate the culture solution with Acetobacter and xylinium, using a culture liquid
store the culture solution in glass jars, covering them with a thin cloth and maintaining them in such condition for the recommended duration
harvest the white-coloured jelly that forms on the top of the culture medium and cut into pieces of appropriate size
clean the jelly using pure water to remove all acids and maintain it in flavoured sugar syrup for the appropriate duration and pack it in glass bottles
carry out fortification of coconut water with sugar and fermentation by inoculation of yeast and then mother vinegar, oxidation and acidification
prepare vinegar from coconut water by using vinegar generators
use the appropriate packing material to pack coconut vinegar
prepare intermediate moisture coconut kernel by removing the moisture content of the mature coconut kernel by osmotic dehydration using osmotic mediums, such as sugar syrup
prepare coconut chips by dehydrating the intermediate moisture coconut kernel and adding different flavours using the required flavour essence in the osmotic medium
use appropriate packing material, such as laminated aluminium pouches, to pack coconut chips and optimise their shelf life
extract oil-protein-water emulsions, i.e. coconut milk, by squeezing freshly grated coconut kernel
use coconut milk directly or by diluting it with water to make various preparations, such as desserts, puddings, cocktails, cakes, cookies, coconut jam, etc.
carry out can packaging of coconut milk in preserve it in the form of cream, milk and dehydrated whole milk
